content.title: 2026 March Madness TV schedule for second round: Tip times, announcers, where to watch NCAA Tournament games
content.text: Getty Images March Madness continues across CBS, TBS, TNT and truTV with eight second-round games on Sunday. Paramount+ subscribers will be able to watch every game airing on CBS, while the March Madness Live app will have every game, period. There's also HBO Max, which carries all the games going up on TBS, TNT and truTV. Sunday begins with three straight games on CBS as No. 7 seed Miami faces No. 2 seed Purdue, No. 7 seed Kentucky takes on No. 2 seed Iowa State and No. 4 seed Kansas meets No. 5 seed St. John's. An interesting nightcap comes on TBS whenNo. 1 seed Florida vs. No. 9 seed Iowa. With the final eight games of the second round on tap, the national championship contenders will be whittled down to a mere 16 before the weekend is out.
